content: The Element.replaceWith() method replaces this Element in the children list of its parent with a set of Node objects or strings. Strings are inserted as equivalent Text nodes. Throws HierarchyRequestError DOMException when the node cannot be inserted at the specified point in the hierarchy.
conclusion: Element.replaceWith() 将节点从父级子节点列表中替换，无返回值；若节点已插入而后续抛错，必须显式原子回滚以避免残留两个节点。
